title: Documentation and Dev Ops
summary: This module provides tools and processes for generating documentation, managing development operations, and ensuring code quality and consistency. It includes sub-modules for documentation generation and CLI/utility scripts.

nodes.label: Documentation Generation
nodes.title: Documentation Generation Sub-module
nodes.description: Handles the creation, processing, and publishing of project documentation. This includes dynamic content, code snippet integration, and search indexing preparation.

nodes.label: CLI & Utility Scripts
nodes.title: CLI & Utility Scripts Sub-module
nodes.description: Provides command-line tools and various utility scripts for testing, maintenance, and cloud integration verification within the AI framework.

edges.label: validates/updates docs
edges.title: CLI Validates/Updates Documentation
edges.description: Utility scripts, such as `update_readme`, interact with and validate aspects of the generated documentation, ensuring consistency.

groups.label: Documentation Pipeline
groups.title: Documentation Build & Content
groups.description: Manages the entire lifecycle of documentation content, from raw source files to the final published site, incorporating dynamic elements.

groups.label: DevOps Utilities
groups.title: Development & Operations Tools
groups.description: Collection of scripts and CLI tools supporting development, testing, and operational tasks, including cloud integration and code quality checks.
